mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear and it is 63 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park.

The City of Verona has announced a new leaf vacuum truck for the fall collection season, so please keep leaf piles separate from brush and off the street to ensure they are collected. Additionally, the building inspection department reminds residents to secure proper permits for home projects.
We have plenty happening locally, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by trivia nights tomorrow at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, and the downtown farmer's market on October 7.
In the weekly police report from September 28, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash on CTH-PB at CTH-M where a driver was cited for failing to keep his vehicle under control.
Today's featured flavor is the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist. The store is open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by and grab a scoop while you can.
